title: Waterproof Dog Raincoat with Hood and Reflective Strips
description:
Keep your dog dry and easy to see on rainy walks with a light, packable raincoat that slips on in seconds.
• Waterproof polyester shell with soft mesh lining
• Detachable hood and reflective strips for low light
• Leash opening on the back for use with a harness
• Adjustable hook-and-loop chest and belly straps
• Measure your dog's back length: S 30 cm, M 36 cm, L 42 cm

title: Waterproof Dog Car Seat Cover for the Back Seat, Hammock Style
description:
Protects your back seat from muddy paws, hair and scratches, and stops your dog slipping into the footwell.
• Fits most cars, SUVs and estates; 137 × 147 cm
• 4-layer waterproof Oxford fabric with non-slip backing
• Hammock design with side flaps and zipped openings for seat belts
• Mesh window so your dog can see you
• Machine washable at 30 °C; carry bag included

title: Cat Carrier Backpack with Ventilated Window, for Pets up to 8 kg
description:
Take your cat or small dog to the vet, on trips or out exploring in a comfortable backpack carrier with a view.
• Fits pets up to 8 kg; inside 32 × 25 × 42 cm
• Ventilation holes and mesh side panels for airflow
• Clear window shields from wind and rain
• Padded shoulder straps, chest strap and internal safety leash
• Removable, washable floor mat

title: Double-Layer Cat Litter Mat, Waterproof, Honeycomb Design, 60 × 45 cm
description:
Catches the litter your cat kicks out or carries on its paws, so less of it ends up scattered around your home.
• Honeycomb top layer traps granules; waterproof bottom layer holds them
• 60 × 45 cm, fits in front of most litter boxes
• Open the side to tip out the collected litter
• Soft on paws; rinse clean with water

title: Sisal Cat Scratching Post 60 cm with Hanging Ball Toy
description:
Gives your cat a place to scratch, stretch and play, which helps spare your sofa and carpets.
• 60 cm tall post wrapped in natural sisal rope
• Wide, stable 35 × 35 cm base covered in soft plush
• Dangling ball toy on a spring
• Simple screw-together assembly

title: Plush Dog Bed with Raised Rim and Non-Slip Base, 80 × 60 cm
description:
A soft, cosy bed with a raised rim your dog can rest its head on and a cushioned base for curling up.
• 80 × 60 cm, suits dogs up to about 25 kg
• Short plush cover with thick polyester fibre filling
• Non-slip, water-resistant base
• The whole bed is machine washable at 30 °C

title: Multi-Level Cat Tree 120 cm with Condo, Hammock and Scratching Posts
description:
A climbing, scratching and napping tower that gives indoor cats room to play and a high spot to watch the world.
• 120 cm tall with 3 platforms, an enclosed condo and a hammock
• 6 sisal-wrapped scratching posts
• Soft plush covering and dangling pom-pom toys
• Wall anchor kit included for extra stability
• Assembly tools and instructions included

title: Dog Rope Toy Set, 10 Pieces, Cotton Chew and Tug Toys
description:
A bundle of knotted cotton rope toys for tug-of-war, fetch and chewing, in different shapes to keep playtime interesting.
• 10 rope toys in assorted shapes and colours, 15–40 cm
• Strong braided cotton-blend rope
• For small to large dogs; replace any toy once it frays
• Always supervise play

title: Interactive Cat Feather Wand Set with 10 Refills
description:
Bring out your cat's inner hunter with flexible wands and a mix of feather, bell and worm attachments.
• 2 telescopic wands that extend up to 90 cm
• 10 swappable refills: feathers, bells and fabric worms
• Bendy steel wire for lifelike movement
• Supervise play and store out of reach afterwards

title: Snack-Dispensing Dog Ball, Durable Natural Rubber, 7 cm
description:
Fill it with kibble or small snacks and your dog has to roll, nudge and chase the ball to get the rewards out.
• 7 cm natural rubber ball, bouncy and tough
• Adjustable opening for different snack sizes
• Keeps dogs busy and slows down fast eaters
• Top-rack dishwasher safe; always supervise play

title: Self-Cleaning Slicker Brush for Dogs and Cats, One-Click Hair Release
description:
Removes loose hair, tangles and dirt in a few strokes, then clears the bristles with a single click.
• Fine, bent stainless steel pins with rounded tips
• Press the button to retract the pins and wipe the hair away
• Non-slip ergonomic handle
• Suits short, medium and long coats

title: Pet Hair Dryer, Low Noise, 3 Heat and 4 Speed Settings, EU Plug
description:
Dries your dog or cat after a bath or a rainy walk much faster than towels, with gentle airflow for calmer drying.
• 1200 W with 3 heat and 4 airflow settings
• Low-noise motor, around 60 dB on the lowest setting
• 4 nozzles including a comb attachment
• Overheat protection; 2 m cable with EU plug

title: Automatic Pet Feeder 4 L with Meal Timer and Voice Recording
description:
Serves your cat or small dog dry food on schedule, even when you are running late or away for the weekend.
• 4 L container for dry kibble from 2 to 15 mm
• Up to 6 meals a day, 1–10 portions each
• Record a 10-second voice message to call your pet to meals
• Power adapter with EU plug included, plus backup for 3 × D batteries (not included)
• Removable stainless steel bowl, dishwasher safe

title: Cat Water Fountain 2.5 L with Filters and Quiet Pump
description:
Fresh, filtered running water that tempts cats to drink, with a pump quiet enough to leave on overnight.
• 2.5 L capacity, several days of water for one cat
• 3 ways to drink: flower spout, gentle stream and still bowl
• 2 replaceable carbon filters included
• Pump stops automatically when the water runs low; USB cable and adapter with EU plug included
• Dishwasher-safe top

title: Raised Double Dog Bowl Stand with Stainless Steel Bowls, 2 × 850 ml
description:
Lifts food and water to a comfortable height for medium and large dogs, and stops bowls sliding across the floor.
• 2 removable stainless steel bowls, 850 ml each
• Stand 12 cm high with non-slip feet
• Bowls are dishwasher safe
• Stand wipes clean with a damp cloth

title: No-Pull Dog Harness, Reflective, with Front and Back Leash Rings
description:
A padded, easy-on harness that spreads pressure across the chest and gives you more control on walks than a collar.
• Front ring discourages pulling; back ring for relaxed walks
• Breathable padded mesh with reflective stitching
• 4 adjustment points and quick-release buckles
• Sturdy top handle for extra control
• Chest girth: S 40–55 cm, M 50–65 cm, L 60–80 cm, XL 75–95 cm

title: Reflective Nylon Dog Leash 1.5 m with Padded Handle
description:
A strong everyday lead with reflective threads for evening walks and a soft handle that is kind to your hands.
• 1.5 m long, 2 cm wide double-layer nylon webbing
• Reflective stitching along the full length
• Neoprene-padded handle
• Swivel metal clip helps prevent tangling
• For dogs up to 40 kg

title: Full-Spectrum LED Aquarium Light with Extendable Brackets and Timer
description:
Shows off the colours of your fish and plants with bright, even light, and a built-in timer keeps a regular day-and-night rhythm.
• Full-spectrum white, blue and red LEDs with 3 modes and 10 brightness levels
• Extendable brackets for tanks 30–45 cm or 45–60 cm long
• Timer for 6, 10 or 12 hours of light a day
• Waterproof housing; adapter with EU plug included

title: Nano Aquarium Starter Kit 20 L with Filter, LED Lid and Heater
description:
Everything you need to set up a small tropical or cold-water aquarium on a desk or shelf.
• 20 L glass tank, 40 × 25 × 28 cm
• Lid with built-in LED light and feeding hatch
• Quiet internal filter (200 l/h) and adjustable 25 W heater
• Fish net, thermometer and water care guide included
• Power adapters with EU plug; fish, plants and gravel not included

title: Small Animal Wooden Hideout and Chew Toy Set, 10 Pieces
description:
A natural playset for hamsters, gerbils, rats and dwarf rabbits, with a cosy hideout to sleep in and plenty to gnaw on.
• Wooden hideout house, 15 × 11 × 10 cm
• 9 chew toys: fruit-wood sticks, rattan balls, a seesaw and a climbing ladder
• Natural wood with no paint or varnish
• Replace chew toys when worn down
